target_customer: Local restaurants paying a monthly subscription (about $399) for creator visits and posts
problem: Independent restaurants need steady local discovery on TikTok, Instagram and AI search but cannot manage creator outreach, booking and content themselves.
business_model: SMB subscription with creators booked by AI agents
product_category: Local creator marketing marketplace for restaurants

founders.name: Yousef Abdelfattah
previous_startups: FaZe Clan (went public on Nasdaq per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he started as a 14 year old YouTuber in 2010.

founders.name: Obaida Albaroudi
education: Johns Hopkins, master's in applied economics
previous_startups: Co-founded a clipping company with Ahmad

competitors.name: Storytime Marketplace
competitors.what: City based influencer marketplace for local retail, dining and service brands

competitors.name: Bestie Bite
competitors.what: AI restaurant discovery and marketing automation entering the US

competitors.name: Peppr Grow
competitors.what: Independent restaurant platform including local content creator access

competitors.name: TikTok Must Eat
competitors.what: Creator driven dining guide and local search

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace matching, booking and messaging with AI agents is standard engineering; the hard part is supply and operations.

defensibility.rationale: Creator and restaurant density in a city creates some local network effect, but several platforms offer similar services.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TikTok launched a creator dining guide and Peppr added creator access; no direct effect on TryNearby known.

market_need_then: Restaurants shift marketing to short form video and AI search. TryNearby claims 120+ paying restaurants, 2,500+ videos, 35M views and 90% monthly retention (company claims on YC launch post).

branding.domain_note: Uses trynearby.com with a try prefix; date unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain benefit led: Word-of-Mouth Marketing on Autopilot for Restaurants

branding.community_and_virality: Thousands of creators on the platform and about 35M video views (company claim); no independent brand press.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear descriptive name but the Nearby name is shared by other companies and no independent brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: TryNearby is an active Summer 2026 YC company with a five person team and a founder with creator economy experience from FaZe Clan. It claims fast subscription growth and high retention in Southern California. No funding is verified and no outcome exists yet.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investors; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. Traction numbers are company claims. Competitor source dates are approximate to the year or month of the article. Completeness pass: The seed round rests on a single database (Dealroom); Caplight instead lists a 500K accelerator round led by Y Combinator dated 2026-06, which conflicts and is not recorded.
